upright.short: Changes, curiosity, a chance for good luck, travel
upright.general: The Six of Swords indicates that the time for change has come. The person wants to change their life but is afraid of everything new due to being a conservative by nature, meaning they will have to deal with some chores. It is possible that the individual will become fascinated by a religious movement, which will completely change their life values and environment. The adaptation period will be successful, and a period of happy events will begin in the new environment, where even strangers will provide help.
upright.in_love: The main meaning of the card is big changes. This can manifest as a breakup with a current partner, but it does not exclude a new acquaintance that will radically change the person's life. It is also possible that a married couple's relationship will reach a new level, such as a joint romantic vacation in a warm country or a shared desire to become parents.
upright.in_situation: The card indicates that a peaceful, happy time is approaching. During this period, important life-changing decisions can be made. Communicating with friends and acquaintances will be beneficial, and potential business partners may emerge among them. It is an auspicious time for learning a new job. Active deeds can help achieve everything, and a new vision of the circumstances will make one want to change their lifestyle without fearing the changes. A person might maximize their natural creative abilities in a new profession.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today is an interesting day that does not portend anything bad. The card says that it is necessary to prepare for changes, and the faster this happens, the easier it will be for the person afterward. The main thing is to control your own destiny and not depend on any circumstances.
upright.card_advice: Do not stop at what has been achieved; it is necessary to show interest in new ideas and creative discoveries. You should listen to your inner voice to understand your true purpose in life, as there are many unrealized talents hidden within a person.

reversed.general: The reversed card is characteristic of people who are used to doing everything slowly and are not easily stirred into action. As soon as an alarming event looms, they begin to lose their footing. It is very difficult for them because they find it hard to leave problems in the past and move forward. Doubts, worries, and the fear of repeating a mistake prevent them from going with the flow of life. People around them must constantly provide help and feed them with positive energy.
reversed.in_love: The reversed card states that quarrels and conflict situations are unavoidable. Neither partner wants to listen to the other, let alone show attention to their problems. The card implies that the person feels deeply emotionally empty in such a tandem. They want to change their life but do not know how to do it. The relationship may have turned into a habit where people become uninteresting to each other. This is a dangerous time, as one of the partners may want to find a new choice. Romantic evenings, joint travel, and pleasant surprises can help revive the routine days.
reversed.in_situation: The person is literally bogged down in problems and does not know how to get out of them. The blame for all of this lies in unwise actions that lead them astray. It is difficult for them to make decisions, and they prefer to avoid responsibility for their inappropriate actions.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Progress may feel slower than expected today. You might find yourself revisiting old worries, doubts, or situations that you thought were already behind you. Delays, hesitation, or difficulty letting go of the past can make it harder to move forward. Instead of forcing change, focus on identifying what is still holding you back. A clearer path will emerge once you stop carrying unnecessary emotional or mental baggage.
reversed.card_advice: Do not allow fear of the unknown or past disappointments to prevent you from moving forward. Accept that every transition involves some uncertainty, and trust that growth often begins outside your comfort zone. Take responsibility for the choices that need to be made, even if they feel uncomfortable. Release what no longer serves you, and avoid becoming trapped in cycles of doubt, procrastination, or regret.
